notes: Hand-reviewed generic vocabulary subtracted from scripts/no-hardcoding.policy.json by `node scripts/check-no-hardcoding.mjs --update`. Entries are literal, case-sensitive, whole-word strings; there is no pattern facility. Every entry must be defensible as generic vocabulary a product file could legitimately use with no knowledge of the demo application - product-owned primitive and layout component names, HTTP method names, and single-token words any application shares. Nothing demo-specific may be listed here: every addition widens the anti-hardcoding gate and needs a justification in review.
